source.name: ATP Tour - PIF becomes Premier Partner of the ATP and naming partner of the ATP Rankings
source.note: ATP announcement: PIF elevated to Premier Partner and first-ever naming partner of the 'PIF ATP Rankings'. PIF's partner page at bnpparibasopen.com/partners/pif also brands it 'Platinum Partner of the ATP Tour' and 'exclusive naming partner of both the ATP and WTA Rankings' (fetched 25 Sep 2026); the atptour.com rankings page shows 'PIF ATP Rankings'.

note: Rankings naming partner (PIF ATP Rankings) and ATP Premier/Platinum Partner. The initial rankings naming deal was announced in August 2024; the 2025 announcement extended it to Premier Partner.
